description: Storage and style come together in the Mackenzie 6 Drawer Dresser. Six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides offer generous space for clothing, bedding, and nursery essentials, all within a beautiful solid hardwood frame finished in warm Brown Maple. The flat top is perfectly sized for a changing pad, creating a convenient diaper station. Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes throughout. Coordinates with the complete Mackenzie collection for a cohesive nursery look that lasts from baby through big-kid years.
